text:
anna: Quick async sync on EU3 region cutover. Target milestone: routing + KMS + compliance smoke by Tue. Owners I have so far: routing=tyler, kms=raj, peering=kai, infra=jenna. Any objections or missing owners?

tyler: ack. Routing plan is ready and pushed to staging cluster. I need certs from security and a thumbs up on failover order.

raj: KMS onboarding in progress. Created key ring and IAM bindings draft. Waiting on security to review key policy doc (shared in drive). ETA EOD Mon for policy signoff.

kai: Peering ticket created (CLOUD-1234). Need infra to update org-level ACLs and provide the production CIDR ranges. Also need BGP details for cross-region failover test.

jenna: Infra will provision EU3 VPCs tomorrow morning. Please confirm exact subnet ranges and NACL expectations so we don't rework.

anna: @security can you confirm cert rotation window and whether KMS keys require HSM-backed material for EU3? Also confirm whether audit logs must stay in EU for residency-tagged customers.

security: Noted. We'll do KMS policy review Monday AM. Cert rotation window is default 02:00-04:00 UTC unless you request a different slot. For HSM requirement: only for regulated tenants — otherwise soft-HSM is allowed for now. Audit logs: we can enforce EU-only forwarding for tenants with residency flag.

tyler: Routing snippet I'm testing in staging: 

```
{"route_policy": {"prefer_regions": ["eu3","eu1"], "failover_order": ["eu1","usw2"], "sticky_session": true}}
```

Can someone confirm the failover order is ok (eu1 then usw2) or should we flip?

raj: Data residency checklist item: log forwarding must be EU-only for customers with residency tags. @sre-bot can we gate logforwarder on tenant.metadata.residency == "eu"?

sre-bot: Task INF-2045 created to add residency filter to log-forwarder, assigned to ops. ETA Tue for a canary deploy.

anna: Current blockers: 1) cert issuance 2) CIDR confirmation from infra 3) KMS CA approval for regulated tenants. Let's aim to clear 1 and 2 tomorrow morning so we can unlock routing tests in the afternoon.

kai: Pinging infra owners on CLOUD-1234 for CIDR ranges and ACL changes.

tyler: PR #456 open with the route policy and unit tests. @maria can you review? It's small, just ordering and a flag.

maria: Will review today, should be quick — will call out any nits in PR.

anna: I'll update the milestone board (Roadmap -> EU3 cutover) and add owners to the release notes. Posting a quick checklist in the board: routing PR, KMS policy review, certs, CIDRs, peering test, canary routing smoke. If anyone wants to take ownership of the canary smoke tests, volunteer here. :thumbsup:

jenna: I'll take canary infra smoke and coordinate with tyler for routing test harness.

anna: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short meeting invite if we need a 15m unblock tomorrow. Otherwise continue async here.
